title: Separate inner and outer entropy budgets for the same tree

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The SAME total uniform P language F_N=family.evaluate on ALL N actual bits, defined fully in family.py. d_N is its fixed public controller's original minimum geometry dimension; fallback is output0,d_N=N+1. Its fixed empty-witness NP verifier is given in proof.md.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"At acceptance let a_0=0<...<a_hp=H be active depths, c_u=ceil(N/2^V_(a_u)), T_u=2^(V_(a_(u+1))-V_(a_u)). I_u and O are the public exact inner/outer maxima defined in proof.md, Stronger certificate. Set B_hp=c_hp and B_u=min(c_u,B_(u+1)+(T_u-2)(I_u-1)+max(I_u,O)-1); f_N=B_0+1, otherwise f_N=N+1. The full B2 bound C_B2(F_N)>=4N-8f_N+8 holds for EVERY integer N>=0. At acceptance f_N<=e_N<d_N, where e_N is the symmetric Q capacity threshold explicitly defined in proof.md; f_N<e_N whenever Q is odd. At EVERY sufficiently large integer length, d_N<=2^ceil(DZ), D=8818127579/2000000000, Z=ceil(L^(3/4))*ceil(B^(1/4)), L=ceil(log2 N), B=ceil(log2(L+1)). Also limsup log2(d_N)/Z<=Cstar6<=440906378851/100000000000, where Cstar6=inf_(S6)(w0+X) and S6 is explicitly defined in proof.md. For each fixed real epsilon>0, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-N^epsilon at ALL sufficiently large integer N; this SAME family has liminf C_B2(F_N)/N>=4. ","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
